links.outcome: Factual correctness and safety of ChatGPT responses to patient questions on endoscopic procedures
links.effect: Generally accurate for EGD and colonoscopy with minor errors; multiple factually incorrect responses on ERCP indications, alternatives, and risks.
links.quote: ChatGPT provided generally correct and safe advice for EGD and colonoscopy but had major factual errors when providing advice on ERCP.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT's factual correctness and safety when answering simulated patient questions about endoscopic procedures.
